changes.title: Legend elders
items: Ten legends redrawn as the ancient elders of their kind: the raven's hoard of tarnished coins, rings and keys; the bat's towering ears and sonar; the moth's staring eyes; the snake's shed skin; the salamander's glowing coals; the newt's tall sail; the heron on one stilt leg in its pool; the spider's rose-window web; the stag beetle's antler jaws; the woodlouse grown into a little house

changes.title: Savanna fix
items: The savanna's acacias stand in groves, the baobabs have shoots and low boughs round their trunks, and the plains' termite mounds stand taller

changes.title: Komodo
items: A new animal for the rocky island to the east: the Komodo dragon, a huge lizard with a flicking forked tongue, in its own dry, rocky savannah of acacias and fan palms
